name: GANGES CHASMA — steep descent by switchback

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 250 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Steep descent by switchback. Chosen for the steepest wall section the scan can find.

blurb: Down a wall of Valles Marineris on loose talus. WorldVLA takes the fall line and slides 0.49 m doing it, through 18 deg of pitch; PragyaSpace cuts diagonally across the grade, brakes into each step, and gives up 0.09 m.

metrics.signature: direct fall-line descent → slip → accelerate → emergency brake/recovery → repeat
diagonal descent → uphill-foot brake → supported hairpin → opposite diagonal → micro-slide arrest → stable exit
